notes.title: Patch Notes for Sep 22
notes.content:
Day 1 patch, with some bug fixes. The following are fixed:
- Some menu buttons inconsistently did not close when clicked
- After resizing the screen, quitting to the main menu changed the screen size
- After changing control scheme to a different keyboard scheme, sometimes starting the game would reset to keyboard and mouse
- There was a typo in an English item description

notes.title: Auridia is AVAILABLE NOW! 🚀 15% Launch Sale!
notes.content: [p]Greetings, Explorers![/p][p][/p][p][b]Today's the big day: Auridia is officially released on Steam![/b][/p][p][dynamiclink href="https://store.steampowered.com/app/3443080/_Auridia/"][/dynamiclink][/p][p align="start"]To celebrate, Auridia will be available with a [b]special 15% discount for the first 14 days of its release![/b][/p][p][/p][p align="start"]But that's not all! I am honored to collaborate with the developers of another excellent indie metroidvania that has beautiful environments, fluid movement, and a similar taste in character outfits: HAAK![/p][p align="start"]We have launched a bundle that includes both Auridia and HAAK, and you will get an additional [b]10% off[/b] on top of the existing discounts when you buy both.[/p][p][url="https://store.steampowered.com/bundle/59218/_X/"]Auridia & HAAK[/url][/p][p][/p][p]In a lot of ways, the release of Auridia is realizing something I've thought about since I was young. I hope that as you experience this world, you can feel the joy and excitement I felt while creating it.[/p][p][/p][p align="start"]Once again, thank you to everybody who supported the development along the way, either by testing, streaming, or just sharing your support. Now grab your cloak and torch, and explore the caverns of Auridia.[/p]

notes.title: Auridia is coming September 22nd!
notes.content: [p align="start"]Hi, fellow explorers![/p][p][/p][p align="start"]I have some news to share with you all today! After over a year of development, Auridia has a release date. [b]\[Auridia] will be officially launching on September 22nd![/b][/p][p][/p][p][dynamiclink href="https://store.steampowered.com/app/3443080/_Auridia/"][/dynamiclink][/p][p align="start"]I couldn't have gotten this far without all your support and encouragement, especially everybody who played early versions and shared their thoughts. That feedback has helped make the game much better, and hearing it has been my biggest motivator over the last year. Thank you so much![/p][p][/p][p align="start"]Come and join our official Discord channel: [/p][p][url="https://discord.gg/6ACVFmzkAy"]https://discord.gg/6ACVFmzkAy[/url][/p][p align="start"]You can chat with other explorers, share your excitement, and stay on top of more updates. I can't wait to see you all in the game on release day![/p][p][/p][p align="start"]Lastly, if you haven't already, please be sure to [b]wishlist the game on Steam[/b]! It's the best way to support a developer like me, and also ensures you get a notification the moment the game goes live.[/p][p][/p][p align="start"]Let's count down together to the start of the adventure![/p]
